findings.title: Focus management in modals and panels — Skip-to-content link updates the URL on activation but does not move focus to the main content region and does not dismiss or hide the button. The main journey (tab through page, interactive elements) is otherwise good.

refs: Notes: Skip-to-content link updates the URL on activation but does not move focus to the main content region and does not dismiss or hide the button. The main journey (tab through page, interactive elements) is otherwise good.

findings.howToFix: After the skip link is activated, programmatically move focus to the #main-content target element (e.g. mainRef.current.focus()). Ensure the target has tabIndex=-1 so it is focusable programmatically.
